Under the terms of the Collaboration and License Agreement, Moderna will make an upfront cash payment to the Company of $35 million, including $5 million of pre-paid research funding. The Company will be eligible to receive future development, regulatory and commercial milestone payments of up to $1.2 billion. Moderna will pay the Company tiered royalties on global net sales of Licensed Products from high single digit to low-teen percentages, subject to certain reductions.
